programme.title: Eric Mintel Investigates

programme.title: Eric Mintel Investigates
programme.desc: Eric Mintel teams up with team member and spirit medium, Dominic Sattele, to embark on a captivating exploration of Perkasie Park's history and enigmatic mysteries. programme.title: Eric Mintel Investigates
programme.desc: Lead investigator Eric Mintel and spirit medium Dominic Sattele descend on New Spirit Old Soul and the 1759 Farmhouse and homestead that accompanies it. programme.title: Eric Mintel Investigates
programme.desc: In part 2 we find Eric and Dominic returning to the Homestead 6 months later only to find activity has ramped up in all that time. As the investigation continues the team finds that another spirit has entered the Homestead and moves the investigation into overdrive! programme.desc: Historically haunted paranormal hot spot with ghostly apparitions, a disembodied voices and playful spirits inhabit the historic Golden Plough Inn in beautiful Bucks County centered next to picturesque Peddler's Village in Lahaska, PA.
